name: Druidcraft
description: You call upon nature's subtle power. Choose one: cause a tiny flame to burst into existence; predict the weather for the next 24 hours; cause a flower to bloom or a seed to sprout; or create a sensory effect (rustling leaves, sound of wind, faint animal call).
effect: You read the weather and the lie of the land: +2 Survival for 4 hours (faster travel, foraging, reading the signs).
notes: Out of combat: +2 Survival for 4 hours. Survival speeds travel, helps you spot an ambush before it's sprung, and drives foraging checks.
Cast it before you set out on the road.
